title: New balance keys parsed with lenient jint: silent float truncation and out-of-i32-range wrap reach the load path
detail: jint truncates JSON floats (2.5 loads as 2) and wraps out-of-i32-range integers through the i32 cast (2^32+1 loads as 1); the >=1 validation cannot catch in-range wrong values — the exact hazard class this file's own jint_strict doc (4.2 hardening) rejects for new catalogs.
recommended_fix: Parse both new keys with the existing jint_strict (fail-fast rejection on float/wrong-type/out-of-range) instead of jint, so a mistyped balance.json errors at load rather than silently loading wrong tuning.
